name: dsh-tracescope
description: 基于 Git 代码差异智能缩减手工测试范围，支持 Web / 移动端操作录制与崩溃日志采集，依托 DSH AI 自动生成可复现缺陷流程，实现变更驱动的手工测试闭环提效插件。A DSH native test assistant plugin. It intelligently narrows manual test scope via Git diff, records web & mobile operation tracks and crash logs, and generates reproducible bug steps through AI analysis to close manual testing workflow efficiently.
